billies-0.blurb: The team behind Billie's Bier Kafétaria fills the Waagnatie warehouse with around sixty of the world's most sought-after craft breweries for two days of unlimited pours.

extra-5.blurb: Antwerp's beer-appreciation society pairs a four-course seafood-leaning menu by the Pirate Chef with a run of carefully chosen beers.

het-archief-0.blurb: A guided tour of France in nine glasses: regions, grapes and styles, with cheese and charcuterie on the table.

the-jane-0.blurb: Antwerp's long-running charity gala: a six-course dinner cooked by a brigade of the city's top chefs, including Nick Bril and Thomas Diepersloot, raising money for HIV research and prevention.

fine-fleur-0.blurb: Antwerp's long-running charity gala: a six-course dinner cooked by a brigade of the city's top chefs, including Nick Bril and Thomas Diepersloot, raising money for HIV research and prevention.

extra-6.blurb: Pastry star Roger van Damme dresses the Botanic Sanctuary's afternoon tea for the holidays, a slow, sweet way to spend a dark December afternoon.

extra-7.blurb: WOLF's Mexican kiosk steps out from behind the counter for a one-night chef's table: five Spanish, Mexican and Latin-fusion dishes with three paired drinks.

extra-8.blurb: Fountainfest turns dinner into theatre at arts house Het Bos: three courses woven together with performance, sound and texture.

extra-9.blurb: A once-a-year chance to taste beers brewed with hops straight off the bine: about seven fresh-hop examples, poured young as they should be.

extra-10.address: Grote Markt and surrounding squares, 2000 Antwerpen
extra-10.blurb: Antwerp's month-long winter festival strings chalets through the old centre, from the Grote Markt to Steenplein: mulled wine, oliebollen, raclette and seasonal snacks, with skating and a big wheel along the way.

extra-11.blurb: A more grown-up corner of the Christmas season on the baroque Hendrik Conscienceplein: local food stands, a sommelier-led wine bar and champagne, plus workshops and live jazz.

django-0.blurb: Natural-leaning online merchant Bottleneck takes over wine bistro Django for a seated year-end tasting: more than sixty wines poured at your table.

extra-12.blurb: Italian wines picked for the holiday table, with a launch for wine writer Kristel Balcaen's new book.

sanctus-0.venue: Hidden Garden & Sanctus, Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp
sanctus-0.blurb: Yves Mattagne cooks a six-course Christmas Eve menu, with caviar, langoustine flambéed with whisky and Burgaud duck, across the Botanic Sanctuary's Hidden Garden and Sanctus.

hidden-garden-0.venue: Hidden Garden & Sanctus, Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp
hidden-garden-0.blurb: Yves Mattagne cooks a six-course Christmas Eve menu, with caviar, langoustine flambéed with whisky and Burgaud duck, across the Botanic Sanctuary's Hidden Garden and Sanctus.

sanctus-1.venue: Hidden Garden & Sanctus, Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp
sanctus-1.blurb: An eight-course New Year's Eve tasting menu by Michelin-starred Yves Mattagne, from scallops with caviar to robata-grilled venison.

hidden-garden-1.venue: Hidden Garden & Sanctus, Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp
hidden-garden-1.blurb: An eight-course New Year's Eve tasting menu by Michelin-starred Yves Mattagne, from scallops with caviar to robata-grilled venison.

extra-13.blurb: Two weeks when Antwerp's chocolatiers and pastry shops (the city's 'pateekes') put out special creations, organised by the bakers' guild Koekenstad.

extra-14.blurb: More than ten leading German estates pour Riesling, Pinot Noir and more at this importer-run fair, a good snapshot of where German wine is now.

het-archief-1.blurb: Nine fresh, spring-minded wine styles, each introduced at the table, at this cosy wine bar near the Meir.

het-archief-2.blurb: A playful guided tasting of nine wines chosen to surprise, with a story behind every glass.

extra-15.blurb: Belgium's biggest tasting festival comes back to the Waagnatie: around fifty restaurants and chefs, from starred kitchens to street food, serving small plates over four days.
